step1_analysis.description: A 24-GHz differential cascode LNA featuring inductive emitter degeneration and base matching. It serves as the first block in the phased-array receiver, providing initial gain and noise figure setting.

paper_reference.title: A Fully Integrated 24-GHz Eight-Element Phased-Array Receiver in Silicon

Voltage Gain.description: Differential AC voltage gain at the 24 GHz operating frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain ≈ gm * Z_load. With Ic ≈ 2mA, gm ≈ 80mA/V. At 24GHz, a 1nH load inductor gives Z_load ≈ 150 ohms. Gain ≈ 12 V/V or ~21 dB, but parasitic capacitances will lower this to ~12-15 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: While the paper reports 43 dB for the full receiver, a single cascode LNA stage at 24 GHz typically provides 10-15 dB of gain.

Center Frequency.description: Frequency at which the LNA achieves maximum gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: f = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(L_load * C_parasitic)). Tuned by L2/L3 and output node capacitance.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The circuit is designed for the 24 GHz ISM/radar band.

Power Consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the LNA from the 1.8V supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. With 0.9V bias and 10k base resistor, Ib ≈ 20uA. For β=100, Ic ≈ 2mA per branch. Total current ≈ 4mA. P = 1.8V * 4mA = 7.2 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the provided 0.9V bias and 10k bias resistors with a generic NPN model.

Noise Figure.description: Signal-to-noise ratio degradation through the LNA.

sky130_expected.calculation: NF = 10 * log10(F). LNA NF dominates the receiver NF.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A single SiGe LNA can achieve <3dB NF, but in standard CMOS/generic models at 24 GHz, 4-5 dB is expected.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain at 24 GHz, and transient response of the differential LNA.
step3_testbench.spice:
* 24GHz Differential Cascode LNA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param L_load=1n L_deg=100p L_base=500p C_val=100f R_bias=10k

* DUT
L1 n5 GND {L_deg}
L2 VDD n6 {L_load}
L3 VDD n1 {L_load}
L4 n3 GND {L_deg}
L5 n4 n9 {L_base}
L6 n2 n10 {L_base}
R1 n2 label_net_0 {R_bias}
R2 n4 label_net_1 {R_bias}
C1 n8 GND {C_val}
Q1 n7 n9 n5 npn
Q2 n1 VDD n0 npn
C2 n4 GND {C_val}
C3 VDD GND 1p
Q3 n6 VDD n7 npn
Q4 n0 n10 n3 npn
C4 n1 n4 {C_val}
C5 n6 n8 {C_val}

* Generic NPN model since SKY130 doesn't have a default 'npn'
.model npn npn (bf=100 is=1e-15 cjc=10f cje=10f)

* Biasing and Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 label_net_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 label_net_1 0 0.9

* AC and Transient Inputs
Cin_p in_p n4 1p
Cin_n in_n n2 1p
Vin_p in_p 0 dc 0 ac 1 sin(0 10m 24G)
Vin_n in_n 0 dc 0 ac -1 sin(0 -10m 24G)

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1G 100G
  let vout_diff = v(n6) - v(n1)
  let gain_db = 20*log10(mag(vout_diff)/2)
  meas ac gain_24G find gain_db at=24G
  meas ac max_gain max gain_db

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 1p 200p
  meas tran vout_max max v(n6)
  meas tran vout_min min v(n6)
  let vpp = vout_max - vout_min
  print vpp
  
  quit
.endc
.end
